name: CHIMERA-4B-RL
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507: 36 full GQA layers (kv heads 8, head_dim 128) and 0 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. An RL fine-tune (SFT then RL on the CHIMERA dataset) of Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507, not a new base model: config.json is identical field for field (2560 hidden, 36 layers, 8 kv heads, head_dim 128, 262144 ctx, tie_word_embeddings true). The safetensors total is 4.411B against the base record's 4.0B, a 388,956,160-parameter difference that is exactly vocab_size 151936 x hidden_size 2560 - the repo's index counts lm_head as a separate tensor even though the config ties it - so the parameter counts are not a like-for-like comparison even though the tensor set is the base's. Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-03-02.
